content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip provide user-friendly interfaces for selling digital products, but their reliance on conventional payment processors limits accessibility in many regions. Both platforms charge fees per transaction and offer varying levels of customer support. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, empowers creators by providing complete ownership of their storefront. This means no hidden fees or reliance on external platforms, allowing creators to focus solely on their products without the usual frustrations of account limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms such as Stripe operate in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving many creators without options for receiving payments. PayPal, while more widely available, can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days with no recourse. Such restrictions create an unstable environment for creators. Sovereign commerce infrastructure avoids these pitfalls entirely, allowing creators in restricted countries to establish a reliable and independent payment solution. With NOWPayments integrated, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring they stay connected to the global market without limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad and Payhip charge transaction fees that can accumulate quickly, especially when creators are just starting. Payment delays are common, with creators often waiting several days to access funds. In contrast, using the Edge Commerce Stack provides automatic payment processing with NOWPayments, where transactions confirm instantly on-chain. At a mere 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements, the cost is clear and predictable, making it an ideal solution for creators who want control over their finances without unnecessary delays.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure means no reliance on external platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical aspect of any digital commerce strategy. With platforms like Gumroad and Payhip, creators often find themselves at the mercy of the platform's policies. In contrast, with sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators fully own their content and customer data post-deployment. The Edge Commerce Stack automates product delivery through integrations with Cloudflare and Supabase, ensuring that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation. This level of automation not only enhances customer satisfaction but also frees creators from manual processing.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you seek immediate deployment and a straightforward setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack may suffice. However, for those who require advanced features like automated delivery and comprehensive control, the Edge Commerce Stack is the better choice. Deployed within 48 hours, it allows for five products and comes fully configured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC, ensuring your emails land in inboxes. Evaluating your needs will help determine the best infrastructure for your digital sales.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Control your payments and data with solutions like NOWPayments.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
